slots.title: U.S. CFTC sets policies on event contract data, using crypto to check financial boxes
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The derivatives regulator issues a rule on data reporting for event contracts and new guidance for how crypto assets can be used to meet regulatory requirements.

slots.title: Ethereum Foundation doubles protocol security team ahead of overhaul
slots.author: Cointelegraph
slots.summary: The foundation said its next upgrade will be harder than the Merge, and the required pace of development will make it easier to ship bugs.

slots.title: Anthropic launches Claude Ship, letting AI agents review, fix, and approve code changes
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: As AI-generated code piles up, Anthropic's new developer tools aim to eliminate another bottleneck by letting agents handle routine approvals.

slots.title: Supertake raises $20M to let AI agents turn your market predictions into stock portfolios
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: Think you know where the market is headed? A startup called Supertake lets you put money behind your ideas without having to pick the stocks yourself.

slots.title: Bitcoin rebound already losing steam as AI trade returns with a bang
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Nvidia jumped more than 30% and has recovered most of its losses since CEO Jensen Huang stepped down, but bitcoin is lagging as U.S. selling persists, traders said.

slots.author: OpenAI Blog
